title: fix: Dashboard widget config live preview sync, data binding bridge, and scatter chart type switch
body:
Dashboard right-side config panel changes (data source, category field, aggregation, etc.) were not reflected in the left-side widget preview in real time. Additionally, switching widget type to `scatter` caused rendering errors. ### Root causes - **`DashboardWithConfig` had no live preview path** — `WidgetConfigPanel` was rendered without `onFieldChange`, so edits only applied on Save. - **`scatter` missing from chart type conditions** — `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` only matched `bar|line|area|pie|donut`, causing `scatter` to fall through to the default handler (`{...widget, ...options}`) which produces an invalid chart schema. - **Data binding fields disconnect** — `DashboardRenderer.getComponentSchema()` only read from `options.xField`/`options.yField`/`options.data`, but the config panel edits `widget.categoryField`/`widget.valueField`/`widget.object`/`widget.aggregate`. There was no bridge between these two field paths, so data binding changes in the config panel had no effect on the rendered widget. - **New widgets from config panel failed to render** — Widgets created via the config panel have `widget.object` set but no `options.data` provider, so chart/table rendering produced empty results instead of constructing proper object-chart/data-table schemas. ### Changes - **`DashboardWithConfig.tsx`** — Add internal `liveSchema` state + `configVersion` counter for real-time preview. Pass `onFieldChange` to `WidgetConfigPanel`. Uses the same draft stabilization pattern as `DashboardView` to prevent `useConfigDraft` reset loops. - **`DashboardRenderer.tsx` / `DashboardGridLayout.tsx`** — Add `'scatter'` to the chart type condition in `getComponentSchema()`. Add widget-level field fallbacks so config panel changes take effect: - `xAxisKey` now reads `widget.categoryField || options.xField || 'name'` - `yField` now reads `widget.valueField || options.yField || 'value'` - When no data provider exists but `widget.object` is set, constructs object-chart schema from widget-level fields (`object`, `categoryField`, `valueField`, `aggregate`) - Same pattern for table widgets: constructs data-table from `widget.object` when no data provider exists - **Tests** — 7 new tests (scatter value/object-chart providers, categoryField override, valueField override, object-chart from widget fields, data-table from widget.object, DashboardWithConfig live preview). All 148 dashboard tests pass. CRM metadata tests (35) also pass. - **ROADMAP.md** — Added P1.10 Phase 10 documenting these fixes.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 【Bug】Dashboard 右侧配置变更后左侧 Widget 未及时刷新，Widget 类型切换异常 > ### 问题描述 > 在 dashboard 页面，当右侧配置面板（如数据源、分类字段、聚合方式等）发生修改后，左侧 Widget 并不会立刻同步变化，导致用户体验不佳。并且在切换 Widget type 时，部分类型会报错不可用。 > > #### 详细复现步骤： > 1. 打开 CRM Dashboard 页面。 > 2. 选择任意 Widget，尝试在右侧面板修改其配置（如数据源、字段等）。 > 3. 此时发现左侧 Widget 并不会立刻刷新内容。 > 4. 切换 Widget type（如 Area Chart -> Pie Chart），部分类型会提示报错且不可用。 > > #### 期望结果 > - 右侧面板配置修改后，左侧 Widget 能够自动刷新。 > - 切换不同 Widget type 时，应当兼容主要常用类型，不应出现不可用报错，或应有友好提示。 > > #### 截图信息 > > > ### 建议修复思路 > - 检查 widget 配置的状态管理（如需响应式 State 或 Context、事件），确保变更能驱动视图刷新。 > - 针对不同 Widget type，增强配置兼容性和类型切换的容错/友好提示。 > > --- > 请修复上述问题，并在修复后确保所有 dashboard 相关 test 通过。修复完成后请同步更新项目 Roadmap。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
